prompt: Single continuous shot, no cuts. Three pots working at once on the stove — one boiling rice, one searing chicken, one roasting vegetables — triple steam columns backlit. The camera glides to a row of glass containers being filled in fast rhythmic layers, rice then vegetables then protein. Money shot: a green herb sauce zigzagged across the entire row in one continuous motion, macro on the glistening layers. Final beat: the tower of stacked containers sliding into the fridge, the door closing with a satisfying weight. Warm light, deep shadows, film grain. Dominant sound: the triple simmer, then the lids clicking. No speech, no voice, no narration, no dialogue, no music.
caption:
Noventa minutos de domingo compram uma semana inteira de "já tá pronto".

Segunda às 19h você só esquenta — e senta.

Manda pra quem quer virar a chave das marmitas 👇
